messages.subject: Discount
messages.body:
Hi,

We had our first rental with you in August and were told we'd be getting the usual discount on our account going forward. Could you confirm whether it's been applied?

Regards,
Insinööritoimisto Vuolle Oy

messages.subject: Re: Discount
messages.body:
Hi,

I've had a look but I'd need a few more details before I can help. Which discount are you referring to, and for which booking? Once I know that I can check what's on your account.

Marko Seppälä
Branch Manager

messages.subject: Re: Discount
messages.body:
Marko,

Quick one - is there an 18m articulated boom lift available? We may need one for a project coming up.

Insinööritoimisto Vuolle Oy

messages.subject: Rental extension
messages.body:
Hi,

Is it possible to get a short extension on my current rental? I need a few more days to finish up. Let me know.

Teemu

messages.subject: Re: Rental extension
messages.body:
Hi Teemu,

Sure thing. I've added a 3-day extension to your current rental, no extra charge. Just return the equipment after the three extra days and you're all set.

Elina Rahkonen
Senior Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Rental extension
messages.body:
I got charged for the extra days but Elina Rahkonen told me the 3-day extension would be free, no extra charge. I returned the equipment within the agreed extension period. Can you please sort this out and remove the charge?

Teemu Alatalo

messages.subject: Delivery options - 20kVA generator
messages.body:
Hi,

We're looking at renting a 20kVA diesel generator for an upcoming site job. What are the delivery options? We'd need it brought out to a location in Oulu.

Thanks,
Oulun Putkiasennus Oy

messages.subject: Re: Delivery options - 20kVA generator
messages.body:
Hi,

Will check availability and delivery slots for the generator and come back to you.

Jussi Kärnä
Rental Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Delivery options - 20kVA generator
messages.body:
Hi Jussi,

One more thing while we're at it. We'd like to book a 1-tonne mini dumper as well, same as our previous rental. Can you set that up?

Oulun Putkiasennus Oy

messages.subject: Re: Delivery options - 20kVA generator
messages.body:
Hi,

Noted on the mini dumper. I'll check what we have and get back to you.

Outi Vähäkangas
Regional Manager

messages.subject: Re: Delivery options - 20kVA generator
messages.body:
We have a problem with the site cabin heater you've supplied. There was a burning smell coming from it overnight and the guys on site are saying it's a fire risk. We've switched it off and disconnected it but someone needs to come look at this today. This can't wait.

Oulun Putkiasennus Oy

messages.subject: Concrete mixer
messages.body:
Hello,

I'd like to book the 140L concrete mixer again, same as last time. What's the earliest I can pick it up?

Mikko

messages.subject: Re: Concrete mixer
messages.body:
Hi Mikko,

I'll look into availability for the mixer and let you know.

Elina Rahkonen
Senior Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Concrete mixer
messages.body:
Hi Elina,

Also, could I add a site cabin to that? Just a single unit, same kind as I had before.

Mikko Rantanen
